notes: Read both targets, context and all eleven candidates. All originals misstate ongoing/past actions or leave actors unresolved. Preserve President Obama and the Democratic Party as joint actors rather than turning their reported actions into future commitments. Restore the omitted open-global-economy assertion. These remain source assertions, not independently verified achievements.

claims.claim_text: In 2012, President Obama and the Democratic Party are investing in access to a complete and competitive education for every American.
In 2012, President Obama and the Democratic Party are investing in affordable health care so Americans, businesses and government are not constrained by rising costs.
In 2012, President Obama and the Democratic Party are investing in training to help U.S. workers adapt and succeed in a rapidly changing global economy.
In 2012, President Obama and the Democratic Party are investing in changes to energy production and use to reduce fossil-fuel dependence and create jobs and industries.
In 2012, President Obama and the Democratic Party are investing in infrastructure that supports commerce.
In 2012, President Obama and the Democratic Party are investing in advanced science and innovation to support the U.S. economy, defense and technological leadership.
In 2012, President Obama and the Democratic Party are making difficult decisions to reduce the U.S. deficit and improve fiscal management.
A growing, open global economy provides opportunities for Americans and strength for the United States.
By 2012, President Obama and the Democratic Party have coordinated economic actions with other countries to address financial crises and prevent renewed boom-and-bust cycles.
By 2012, President Obama and the Democratic Party have reformed international institutions to give emerging economies greater roles and responsibility.
By 2012, President Obama and the Democratic Party have promoted free and fair trade.
By 2012, President Obama and the Democratic Party have supported global economic development.
